## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

According to the narrative framework recorded in the tradition, the Buddha recounted the story while residing at Jetavana with reference to a young lady, opening with the phrase "Your own idea".

In the context of Southeast Asian Buddhist legal and literary history, the story (cited as *Vinaguna Jataka*) appears among several scriptural texts cited in Burmese legal digest (*dhammathat*) excerpts to establish that specific legal precepts were in perfect harmony with the sacred canon [Williams 2005].
